correctness.rationale: The polynomial p_s satisfies all three L2 moment equations, and distributional variation counts both cell-end jumps plus the interior |p_s derivative|. Exact factored derivatives and sign intervals prove the unique off-centre optimizer modulo reflection. The Stieltjes derivative decomposition proves the universal BV estimate on any locally finite mesh, and an interval-indicator with endpoints in separate cells attains it. CHECKER.py reproduces exact moment and stationary identities plus independent stress tests; finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The canonical broken quadratic L2 projector has an explicit, sharp mesh-independent BV seminorm strictly above 2, attained by compact step data. Its genuinely off-centre extremizer and exact branch transition diagnose a nontrivial oscillation mechanism. This yields a natural reference bound for high-order discontinuous polynomial reconstruction and variation-limiter design, not a renamed or arbitrary special case.
